architectural_units.name: Mobile Device
architectural_units.description: The physical device where the application is hosted, either iOS or Android.

architectural_units.name: Waapiti Server
architectural_units.description: API of the company that the application consumes, responsible for communicating with the database and other services hosted on AWS.

architectural_units.name: Presentation Layer
architectural_units.description: The layer that communicates with the user, displaying system data and collecting user input; in this case, the mobile application.

architectural_units.name: Domain Layer
architectural_units.description: The layer that contains the business logic, processing information and performing necessary operations.

architectural_units.name: Data Layer
architectural_units.description: The layer that contains the information.

architectural_units.name: Store
architectural_units.description: The component that contains the state and logic of the application.

architectural_units.name: Action
architectural_units.description: A Javascript object that indicates an intention to modify the application state.

architectural_units.name: Dispatcher
architectural_units.description: The central axis that manages the entire data flow and notifies Stores when the state should be modified.

architectural_units.name: React Native
architectural_units.description: Development framework used to build the mobile application.

architectural_units.name: Redux
architectural_units.description: Library used to manage the application state.

architectural_units.name: AWS SNS
architectural_units.description: Service used for push notifications.

architectural_units.name: Firebase Cloud Messaging
architectural_units.description: Messaging service for Android devices.

architectural_units.name: Apple Push Notification Service
architectural_units.description: Messaging service for iOS devices.

architectural_units.name: HTTP
architectural_units.description: Communication protocol used between the mobile application and the Waapiti API.

architectural_units.name: WebSocket
architectural_units.description: Communication protocol used for real-time logs and preview.
The mobile application interacts with the Waapiti API using HTTP requests.
The Waapiti Server communicates with the database and other services hosted on AWS.
The Dispatcher notifies Stores when the state should be modified.
The application connects via socket with the server to show content in real time.
Via sockets, logs can be received in real time.
The application uses Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) for Android devices and Apple Push Notification Service (APNS) for iOS devices to receive push notifications.

patterns.name: Three Layers
patterns.description: This architecture follows the 3-layer model: Presentation, Domain, and Data.

patterns.name: Flux
patterns.description: An architecture for handling and flowing data in a web application, designed to replace the Model-View-Controller (MVC) pattern.

patterns.name: Observer
patterns.description: A design pattern to observe the state of an object in a program, reflected in the Flux architecture where stores act as subjects.

patterns.name: Decorator
patterns.description: A design pattern that allows adding behavior to an object, used here to facilitate testing tasks.

patterns.name: Lazy Loading
patterns.description: The concept of loading objects/components only when they are necessary.
